title: Laksa's deploy reads CI; the suite and the prod compile run once
status_reason: moved to laksa's own thread on hv's ruling 2026-11-13: laksa#0058
objective:
Laksa (design.md section 7; dialog section 6): `bin/.devbin/cmd/build`'s deploy requires a green `ci-state` on HEAD's sha and stops re-running credo and the suite on a sealed or CI green; the crate's tests run once per `test all` (`test/cli/crate_gate_test.exs`); the local `mix release` gate moves to a CI job (Q11); `.github/workflows/ci_cd.yml` gains a cargo cache or drops the crate build from the CI suite; `bin/.devbin/help/build.md`. Serves AC-4.3.
 Laksa declares `release.ci.workflow: ci_cd.yml` (and no summary, so the run's own conclusion is the verdict) with no other release key; WP02b makes a release block of only ci keys valid for exactly this case.


Record (vc, 2026-10-31): Laksa's laksa#ISSUE:0058 is the one place this work is written and claimed; this package points at it. The pre-sweep set S1 to S4 (laksa-vc, approved by vc the same day) needs no new core: a cargo cache for native/cli; a CI release job running `bin/devbin build release` under MIX_ENV prod at job level, the local gate staying until the deploy reads the job; crate_gate's two full runs narrowed to one; the help pages. The paths-ignore seam (board commits leave HEAD with no run) is closed by WP03's ci-state walk, which reads the push trigger's ignored paths from the workflow at the asked sha.
